scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A Coulomb ground-state density without Kohn-Sham ensemble representation” (preprints/A-Coulomb-Ground-State-Density-without-Kohn-Sham-Ensemble-Representation-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 278 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5a9d714fd656a2c9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Set D = 10200 and ez = (0, 0, 1). There is a finite positive integer Z, specified by Equation (7.10), for which the Coulomb Hamiltonian HC = 3 ∑︂ i=1 (︃ − 1 2 ∆i − Z |ri − (D/Z)ez| − Z |ri + (D/Z)ez| )︃ + ∑︂ 1≤i<j≤3 1 |ri − rj| has a normalizable absolute ground state Ψ in the sector Sz = 1/2, normalized by ∥Ψ∥2 = 1, but there is no v ∈ V and no ground-state ensemble Γ of Hs(v) such that nΓ = nΨ almost everywhere on R3 .
